# One `*` row per file gives the file's verdict; the other rows are statements.

# spec_status (dup:<ID> | new | conflict:<ID> | stale[:<ID>] | open:<ID> | - for a verdict row), target chapter,
# action (cite | absorb | open | rationale | none | keep | cite-only | design-record | absorb-delete), notes.
